blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, AGUSAN DEL SUR— Caraga’s most wanted person, who is facing nine counts of alleged rape of a minor, was arrested in Sibagat, Agusan del Sur over the weekend. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office-13 director, said Sibagat police arrested “Nillo,” 49, a resident of Sibagat town, at 9:34 p.m. on Friday by virtue of an arrest warrant. The warrant was issued by the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 7 in Bayugan City on November 20, 2025. No bail was recommended against the suspect.
